title: FX Brief — 28 Jul 2026
intro:
Broad USD strength dominates as risk-off sentiment weighs on commodity currencies and European majors, with JPY showing resilience despite elevated yield differentials.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
1. USD +0.27% — Safe-haven demand and robust dollar positioning driving gains across the board
2. CHF +0.20% — Secondary safe-haven bid supporting franc against European currencies
3. JPY +0.05% — Holding ground despite USD/JPY above 163, intervention speculation capping losses
4. EUR -0.18% — Modest weakness on growth concerns, underperforming against USD but stable vs GBP
5. CAD -0.22% — Oil-linked weakness offsetting any USD/CAD support from North American correlation
6. AUD -0.28% — Commodity currency pressure and China slowdown fears weighing on aussie
7. GBP -0.35% — Sterling lagging on domestic economic uncertainty and BoE dovish tilt expectations
8. NZD -0.40% — Worst performer as risk-off amplifies typical kiwi vulnerability and carry unwind
